title: Old-fashioned rice cookers are extremely clever
summary: Technology Connections explains how old-fashioned non-electronic rice cookers work, using a magnet and spring switch tripped by the Curie point. It shows the thermodynamics and magnetism behind a simple appliance.
why: HN recommends it as a delightful breakdown of the cleverness in dumb appliances and an entry point to the channel.

quote.text: I had no idea they were so clever, combining thermodynamics and the physics of magnetism.
